maya: New intake: orion-9b v1 came in from model-hub. Observed an attention-phase shift on long-context gen -> KV cache drift after ~2k-4k tokens. Suspect RoPE/rotary handling with quantized kernels. Tagging eng-ml for triage. TL;DR: priority check for runtime parity + quantization smoke.

jamal: I pulled weights and ran a quick generate. Tokenizer is standard BPE. Repro on runtime-x: repeated pattern at ~2200 tokens. Logs: 
```
WARNING: kv_cache_mismatch at layer 23 step 2200
latency spike 2.8s
```
Will run q8 and q4hf next.

sasha: Thanks. Proposed triage order: 1) FP16 long-context smoke (8k) 2) q8 matrix 3) q4hf parity check with rotary scaling restored. Also run attention-norm diff vs reference. Who owns the quant runs? @jamal?

eva: I can own quant runs. Starting q8 -> q4hf matrix today. ETA EOD for first pass. Need a tiny eval set that stresses referent tracking + repetition — @maya can you paste a few prompts?

maya: Pasting quick eval seeds (small):
- continue a legal contract clause with swapped entity names (checks referent stability)
- long code file continuation (3k+ tokens)
- multi-turn chat where referent changes after 3k tokens
Also include perf counters (kv hits, eviction events, per-layer latency).

jamal: Quick note: runtime change in commit 5b2b3 touched rotary scaling and a micro-optim for kv flush. Could be kernel mismatch with quantized path. Rolling toy-build with older rotary path to compare.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: orion9b-v1 -> runtime-x/toy-build initiated on dedicated pool-3 for smoke. canary id c-9873.

sasha: :thumbsup: If q4hf shows KV mismatch, fallback should route requests to q8 or FP16 until we have parity. Also add regression alert if repeat rate > 0.5 on our eval set.

eva: Ran q8 matrix: token-diff/err rates are low. q4hf shows drift concentrated in layers 18-24. Uploading detailed logs: s3://redwood-debug/orion9b/q4hf-drift-2163000000.log

maya: Thanks — prioritization: P1 (hotfix) if any customer-facing workloads require >4k context. Otherwise P2. Recommend gating q4hf on hosted catalog until rotary kernel parity is confirmed.

jamal: Next steps for eng-ml: bisect rotary commits touching kernel selection, run attention-diff tool across long-prefix tests, and add a unit test to runtime for long-prefix kv caching under quantized kernels. I'll open a follow-up thread with bisect artifacts.

sasha: I'll add items to the onboarding checklist: 'rotary kernel parity test', 'kv eviction under quantized paths', 'attention-pattern histogram + drift alert'. Updating the onboarding doc now.
